thinking.camera_strategy:
基于科技风（科技/未来）的风格映射和MasterShots权力动力学规则：
1. **问题阶段 (Block 1-3)**: 应用孤立感 + 权力弱势 - 使用低角度拍摄空间/家具（问题主导） - 高角度拍摄消费者（弱势） - 浅景深突出消费者孤独感 - 静态构图和缓慢推入制造压抑感
2. **权力反转 (Block 4)**: 产品介入的戏剧化转变 - 从Ducth角度（混乱）转为精确直线轨道 - EGB灯光展示：宏转宽过渡 - 灯光从临床白/蓝转向多彩LED - 消费者角度从高变低（获得权力）
3. **成功阶段 (Block 5)**: 连接与协同 - 平行运动：消费者与产品和谐 - 深景深：空间清晰广阔 - 无人机全景展示空间自由 - 干净的双人镜头（消费者+产品）
4. **风格映射**: 科技/未来 - 摄影：无人机扫射、宏转宽过渡、精确直线轨道 - 灯光：临床白/蓝、LED条纹、眩光点缀 - 音频：合成器上升音、清脆高频、静默作为标点

style_mapping.camera: 无人机扫射，宏转宽过渡，精确直线轨道移动
style_mapping.lighting: 临床白/蓝，LED条纹，眩光点缀
style_mapping.audio: 合成器上升音，清脆高频，静默作为标点

block.camera_angle: High Angle on Consumer (弱势), Low Angle on Fixed TV Wall (问题主导)
block.camera_movement: Static framing, 缓慢向后拉镜头 (reveal trapped space)
block.focus_depth: Shallow DOF (Consumer in focus, background blurred)
block.lighting: Clinical white overhead lighting with harsh shadows, minimal ambient fill
block.audio_direction: 低沉的氛围音乐，轻微的压抑感。音效：沙发细微的吱吱声，空间回声被放大
block.power_dynamic: 问题主导（固定空间和家具拥有视觉权力，消费者被压迫）
block.visual_note: Frame within a frame: 通过门窗、家具线条将消费者框在构图中心，增强"被困感"

block.camera: CUs of consumer's frustrated expressions, MS of failed attempts
block.camera_angle: Eye-level but with Dirty Over-the-Shoulder shots (混乱的电线、家具前景)
block.camera_movement: Handheld wobble (混乱感), Rapid whip pans between failed attempts
block.focus_depth: Rack focus between consumer and problematic objects (混乱的线路)
block.lighting: Cool blue tones with clinical white accents, shadows become more pronounced
block.audio_direction: 音乐逐渐焦虑，节奏加快。音效：家具拖动声、电线缠结声、小物件掉落声
block.power_dynamic: 问题持续主导，消费者挫败感累积。视觉混乱反映内心状态
block.visual_note: Dutch angle shots (10-15度倾斜) 增强不稳定感和挫败感

block.camera: ECU on consumer's face (绝望表情), WS of chaotic space
block.camera_angle: Extreme High Angle on consumer (彻底弱势), Low Angle on chaotic mess (问题达到顶峰)
block.camera_movement: Slow Push-in on consumer's face (claustrophobia), Static wide shot of chaos
block.focus_depth: Very shallow DOF - only consumer's eyes in focus, everything else blurred
block.lighting: Harsh contrast lighting - deep shadows on consumer's face, single source highlighting the chaos
block.audio_direction: 音乐突然停止，只有环境音：混乱的嗡嗡声、远处模糊的聊天声。主角深吸一口气的声音被放大
block.power_dynamic: 问题达到绝对主导，消费者处于完全无助状态（情感低谷）
block.visual_note: 使用frame within a frame：消费者被门窗/家具线条完全包围，视觉上"囚禁"

block.camera: Macro shot of remote button → Wide shot of product reveal
block.camera_angle: Low Angle on consumer (获得权力), Product shot at eye-level (平衡)
block.camera_movement: Precise linear dolly forward to product, Smooth orbit around EGB lights
block.focus_depth: Deep focus - consumer and product both sharp, background gradually clears
block.lighting: Dramatic shift: From harsh white to EGB blue glow, LED streaks forming patterns, lens flares on metal surfaces
block.audio_direction: 轻柔但有力的电子音乐开始响起，未来感和魔法感。音效：EGB灯光亮起的细微电子声、滑轮平滑滑动声（几乎无声但能被感知）
block.power_dynamic: POWER SHIFT: 消费者通过产品重新获得控制权。产品作为"空间魔法棒"赋予权力
block.visual_note: EGB灯光展示：1) Macro shot of individual LED diodes lighting up 2) Drone sweep revealing full light pattern 3) Light painting effect in slow motion

block.camera: Clean Two-Shots (consumer + product), Drone sweeps of transformed space
block.camera_angle: Low Hero Angle on consumer (完全掌控), Balanced eye-level shots
block.camera_movement: Parallel movement with consumer (harmony), Smooth transitions between modes
block.focus_depth: Deep focus throughout - entire space is clear, vast, full of possibilities
block.lighting: Scene-specific lighting modes: 1) Cinema - deep blue glow with soft backlighting 2) Gaming - dynamic RGB patterns with LED streaks 3) Party - multi-color ambient with lens flares
block.audio_direction: 音乐达到高潮，充满解放感和喜悦感，科幻电影般的宏大感。音效：不同模式切换时灯光变化的电子音效、人们愉悦的笑声
block.power_dynamic: 消费者完全掌控，产品作为工具和谐共存。空间从限制变为画布
block.visual_note: Three-mode montage: 1) Cinema - cool tones, intimate framing 2) Gaming - vibrant colors, dynamic camera moves 3) Party - wide shots showing full space transformation
